**The window opens on a single spine column.** Column 0, `holE`, is carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls. The model names 99% of them, at 0.03 bits.

**The `man` genes**, columns 24 to 26, are [[mannose transport]]. Then columns 27 to 70, `yoaL` to `ydjK`, are variable, carried by 67 to 87%, and a branch of 3 families runs through columns 77 to 79 in 11 to 24%.

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 99 against 93%, and hesitates less there, 0.03 against 0.30 bits. Its most hesitant column, 70, `ydjK`, is a variable column, at 0.90 bits.

**The window ends on fork columns.** Columns 77 to 79, `pncA` to `sppA`, are carried by 60 to 82%. The last column is `sppA`, in 60% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 93% of genes**, 0.30 bits on average, perplexity 1.4 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 0.93 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 98%.

label: holE
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the holE window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor holE, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 1,892 to 1,971 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying holE once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 93% of genes, 0.30 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,494 calls, named 99%, 0.16 bits; shell 7,343 calls, named 69%, 0.83 bits; cloud 283 calls, named 6%, 4.16 bits. Outside an RGP 35,743 calls, named 98%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 7,377 calls, named 71%, 0.93 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 32 fork, 47 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.93 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 98%); 7,377 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 70 (ydjK, a variable column) 0.90 bits, RGP 72%; column 71 (ydjJ, a fork column) 0.84 bits, RGP 80%; column 5 (yebW, a fork column) 0.81 bits, RGP 3%. The 13 columns (columns 41-46 and 69-75) where most calls are in an RGP: named 80%, 0.53 bits on average; the other 67 columns: named 96%, 0.25 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99%, 0.03 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 93%, 0.30 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 70, is a variable column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: holE. named 99%; 0.03 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 60-89%, 66 P, 13 S, RGP 0.2-80%. named 59-99% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 70, named 59%, 0.90 bits.
[S2.b1]    a second branch of 26 families through columns 1-26, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 11%, all P; the branch's families: yobB, exoX, ptrB, yebE, yebF, yebG, purT, kdgA, edd, zwf, hexR, pyk, lpxM, mepM, znuA, znuC, znuB, ruvB, ruvA, yobI, yebB, ruvC, yebC, nudB, aspS, yecD
